summary: Keep physical reader cost tokens through standalone snapshot cleanup so read-loan duration includes the full snapshot callback without double-counting borrowed snapshots.

schema.detail: No durable or wire schema changes.

compatibility.detail: The read-loan duration counter now includes the full physical checkout of standalone read snapshots. Snapshots borrowing an enclosing request loan still use its single physical-loan token.

downtime.detail: No migration or coordinated downtime is required.

recovery.detail: No persisted state changes; ordinary binary rollback applies.
